articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Watching the Cat Distribution System work its magic is like looking at the most heartwarming magic show in the world.
Nobody knows how the Cat Distribution System actually works. Not even we here at the I Can Has Cheezburger HQ. But they (it?) have three parts to their name, so I'll try my best to explore and explain what the CDS actually is in three parts - just like the three cats it sent to this one woman below.
Firstly, cat. When you talk about the CDS, you talk about cats. There are plenty of cats in need out there on the streets - some are hungry, others are suffering extreme weather conditions, and other cats deal with all of these while also giving birth to kittens outside. That's a crazy thought to hold, especially if you're a cat lover. For me at least, it's hard thinking there are cats outside right now that might need help that I can't give them at the moment. It breaks my heart a little.
Secondly, distribution. The CDS doesn't just deal with cats - it sends them where they need to go. Or, you know, it distributes them. Somewhere out there, there's a human who will give a cat a forever home, and that might just be this specific human and that specific cat. And that distribution part is what makes this matchmaking take place. But how do they know to match the right cat to the right person, and vice versa?
That's where the third part comes in, the system. It's not random, despite it being seen as such. Take this one woman who tells her CDS story below - it seems like such a coincidence that she'd be chosen for a match three times, but that's not a random chance at all. This is the CDS at work. You see, she already had five cats, which immediately flagged her as a safe space for cats on the CDS side. They didn't wander into her yard "just because" - they went there to meet their forever home. It's exactly where and when they should've been.
articles.title: ‘The Cat Distribution System chose my yard 3 times’: Woman’s five-cat household grows to eight over two years, and every new arrival opens the family's heart a little more

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Some cats are just wilder than others.
There are cats who can sit on your lap all day long, only taking food and bathroom breaks because they have to - and then returning to steal some more of your body warmth (and your heart). But then there are the absolute demons, the spawns of satan who were probably pspspsed here during a dark summoning ritual. My cat is not like that. Sure, she has the occasional zoomies trip in the middle of the night, but she's not the complete ruckus mess some other cats are. My friend's cat, though… he's another story completely.
Way before I had a cat of my own, I took a vacation for a month, and it just so happened that this friend needed a place to stay. I sublet my room to her and her cat. She warned me he's a wacky one, and this wasn't news - I already heard the stories about him directly from her. The Prophet was his name. Well, Elijah initially, but the more character he's shown as he grew up, the more it became clear he needed his own title. So… Elijah The Prophet, yes? He's an absolute maniac.
When I came back home after the sublet/vacation period, I returned to a room I did not recognize. The curtains were rolled up above the window, the computer was on the highest shelf of my closet (yes, inside), and the office chair was shredded to pieces. That was the art exhibition The Prophet left me. Or, more accurately, his hooman. The chair thing was inevitable, but the curtains and my PC were thoughtfully well-defended. But with that being said, I don't think I'm about to host that crazy cat in my house ever again. At least the story I was left with is funny, as are all this cat's other stories.
articles.title: 31 Feline Funnies for People Raising Ruckus Cat Children

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
Rehoming a cat, sometimes, is the kindest choice. 
Generally, of course, we are against cats being rehomed. There are so many solutions to so many issues that can be found. Letting your cat go should always be the last choice. Because as smart as cats are, they are still just cats, and they don't understand rehoming. They just think that they were abandoned by their owners. But sometimes, when the problem is insurmountable, surrendering your cat is not only the right choice, it's also the kindest one. 
We always say that people should adopt a cat when they are ready, when they have enough stability in their lives. If that stability is gone, and if it can't be brought back, then you should not have a cat. It's simple to understand, but it's not easy to do. Of course, people do it all the time. We could write stories about abandoned cats every day, and we wouldn't run out. The only thing that we ask is that if you have to do it, do it right. Don't throw your indoor cat onto the street to fend for themselves. Find them another home if you can, and if you can't, take them to a shelter. So that they have an actual chance to be found by a new person who will love them just as much as you did. Like the person in today's story loves this cat.
articles.title: 'To the person who loved my cat before': Person writes a heartfelt letter to their cat's previous owner who loved the cat but had to let him go to a new home

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
Each cat has their own unique and ever so slightly hilarious way of showing affection. 
I did not grow up with cats. Despite that, I thought that I knew cats. I always loved them. Pspspsing cute stray cats was one of my favorite activities forever and always. And I did know a lot. But not everything. Of course, a bunch of things ended up surprising me. The fact that cats have purrsonalities - like, the fact that they are really opinionated and like making sure that we know their opinions. The fact that cats are smart - that they learn our patterns and use that knowledge against us all the time. And the fact that they even though cats hate vet visits, they love giving us heart attacks sometimes and forcing us to take them. 
But one thing about cats that I thought was obvious that ended up taking me by surprise is that cats show affection in all kinds of silly ways. I knew about the meaning of slow blinking, and I knew that if a cat comes to cuddle you, that's basically a declaration of love. I did not know that them showing you their bootie is a sign of affection. I didn't know that my cat sleeping by my feet in bed is them showing love. For my cat specifically, I didn't know that her running to greet me when I come home is a way of showing affection until I realized that she only does it for me and no one else. And for Rotisserie Chicken - the kitty in today's story… showing love means being a rotisserie chicken.
articles.title: Kind person adopts their friend's cat after they suddenly pass, and finds out the cat asks to be held in the silliest way: 'Rotisserie Chicken has learned that he needs a box he can't fit in to communicate he wants to be held'

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
We have a theory that everyone is secretly a cat person. Some people just haven't met the right cat yet. You can spend your entire life insisting you're a dog person, but all it takes is one adorable little face to make you reconsider everything you thought you knew about yourself.
Of course, we understand why some people are hesitant around cats. Unlike dogs, who tend to make their feelings pretty obvious, cats can be a little harder to read. One minute they're rubbing against your legs, and the next they're looking at you like you've committed some terrible offense. Their affection often comes on their own terms, and earning their trust can take a little patience.
But that's also part of what makes getting close to a cat so rewarding. The first time a shy kitty approaches you for attenti…
articles.title: Lifelong dog person never imagined becoming a cat lover until one frightened shelter kitty stole their heart

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
If you think your conversations at home are private, you clearly don't have a cat. These nosy little creatures have a habit of appearing whenever something interesting is happening, especially when it doesn't involve them. Whether you're gossiping with a friend or having a serious conversation, there's a good chance your feline roommate is listening.
Cats are naturally curious animals, and they seem particularly interested in whatever their humans are doing. You could spend hours trying to get your kitty's attention, only for them to suddenly become fascinated by you the moment you pick up the phone. Hearing one side of a conversation is far more entertaining than playing with the expensive toys you bought them.
Some cats aren't particularly subtle about their eavesdropping, either. They'l…
articles.title: Purrivate Conversations Are Impossible With These Nosy Cats Hiding Around Corners To Eavesdrop

articles.author: Celeste Mello
articles.description:
Would you give a band a chance just because every member was a cat?
I absolutely would. I'm in a neo-soul band, but unfortunately, none of us are cats. That would have been hilarious. In fact, we tried to make our bassist's cat part of the band, but his cat wasn't so interested. He ran away during every practice session and only came back for the food.
For a big part of my life, I enjoyed music as a listener. I grew up listening to other people's songs. I went through a pop era that revolved around Justin Bieber, a punk era led by Green Day, an alternative rock era with The Strokes and Arctic Monkeys, and an emo era with My Chemical Romance. These days, I'm also a Swiftie. As you can see, my playlists have been through a lot. But I hadn't made my own music until I started playing drums and joined a band in 2021. Becoming friends with my bandmates and making songs together changed my relationship with music. So for about five years now, we've been creating our own songs, which has given me another way to enjoy music. I can try cool grooves with my friends and help turn something we're playing around with into something interesting.
Musicians know that listening to your finished album is one of the most satisfactory experiences. We finally have the recorded result of all that time we spent making music together, recording, editing, producing... So after years of getting attached to other people's songs, it's nice to think that someone might discover ours and connect with them too.
articles.title: 20 Cats With Musical Instruments Looking Like They’re About to Drop the Album of the Year

articles.author: Cata Holmes
articles.description:
Who needs scary monsters when you've got your cat dressed as one?
Why do we love dressing up our cats? It's a crazy thing to think about, since most cats don't like being touched or put in clothes. But there's something so cute about it that literally melts everyone's hearts. The most adorable part is that every cat looks so cute and tiny in those little clothes that fit them perfectly. Just look at the pictures I gathered below, and you'll see what I mean; it'll be impossible not to consider dressing your cat in any of these costumes this Halloween.
Cat costumes don't have to be elaborate or complicated. You can put them in a little vinnie, a hat, or some booties, and they'll be ready to go trick-or-treating with you. But it's important that you consider their safety and happiness before your own desires. Because if it were up to us, we'd dress up our pets every day, not just on Halloween, but if you know your feline isn't a fan of clothes and doesn't really like being touched or held… maybe that isn't an option this year. That's a boomer…
The good thing is that, for some reason, there're multiple cats out there that actually enjoy wearing costumes and look happy in the ones they got this year. So, for the rest of us humans who don't own a cat or really don't know any cat who likes to wear clothes, we can have a wonderful time looking at this gallery. I'm already excited to see more ideas like this!
articles.title: 'Happy Meowloween!': 22 Cats in Halloween Costumes Ready for a Spooktacular Party

articles.author: Celeste Mello
articles.description:
What is it about a tiny kitten that makes adults forget how to have a normal conversation? Why am I using my baby voice again?
I can be talking about work or explaining something from class sounding like a true professional. When a kitten appears, I forget how grown-ups talk. Hiii, baby! Who's a little baby? The kitten is just sitting there while I'm asking him silly questions about why their face is so small. 
I do this with cat pictures, too. I can be looking at my phone and say, "Oh, look at you!" out loud while scrolling through Instagram reels. Even though there's no cat actually there to receive the compliment. It can be a stranger's kitten, but he showed up in my feed, so he's getting my compliment. He will never know this, but I don't care. He's completely unaware that I love his cute little eyes.
You know that baby voice we use with our pets? Sometimes we don't even realize we've switched. Well, researchers studied it. A 2022 study found that people speak at a higher pitch when addressing cats than when talking to adults. It's called cat-directed speech. So yes, the voice I hope nobody overhears has a name and a study. 
And don't you feel your cat notices when you speak to them and not to someone else? That is actually real. Cats can pick up on the difference. In a small study involving 16 cats, researchers played recordings of their owners and strangers speaking. The cats distinguished between speech addressed to them and speech addressed to adults when their owner was talking, but didn't show that distinction with strangers. Isn't that sweet? Your voice means something to your cat.
articles.title: Your Weekly Delivery of 25 Soft and Silly Kitten Memes for a Midweek Mood Boost (October 21, 2026)

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Cat person or not, seeing stray cats in need always moves something in people's hearts.
I was not always a cat person, but that changed when I started living with a cat. The cat was not mine, he officially belonged to a roommate I lived with when I was a student. This is the cat that made me warm up to cats, the previously self-described "dog person, but cats are also okay I guess". It made me love cats so much that I adopted my own cat, my beloved Cassie, whom I held in my arms for the first time when she was a month-old kitten. She's seven now, and the queen of my heart.
But that's the meowgical power of cats over people. They might not be "cat people" like us - dedicated fans and feline fanatics - but their hearts are opening up to the possibility. And that's how cat people are made, just by being around cats, learning to live by their side, or seeing that they're in need. This latter option is what this one woman experienced and shared with the broader online feline family - she was not a cat person. But one mama cat and her two kittens lived outside her house for a few months, in the grueling heat, in need to be homed.
It's a psychological phenomenon that works between humans too. It's called "the helper's high", and it basically describes the release of oxytocin (the bonding hormone) in our brains when we engage in prosocial behavior. That's the "high" we experience when we want to help someone, and definitely when we do help someone. And that someone can be a cat… or a cat mama and her kittens, living outside your house. And with this phenomenon, it really isn't that surprising that more people than not are becoming cat people.
articles.title: Neighbor who never saw herself as a cat person catches a mama cat and her two kittens after several months of watching them roam the block: ‘You saved 3 lives.’

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
Cat memes are the purrfect sweetener to add into your hot cup of coffee.
There are three things that I need to start my morning on the right paw. They are simple. The first one is a kiss on my cat's forehead. I must have that. If I don't… morning ruined. The second thing is my coffee. And I'm very specific about how I make it. If my husband gets it wrong… morning ruined. But the third thing is what really makes a difference, and sometimes I don't quite follow through with this thing. Who has the time in the morning, when you're rushing to get ready for work, to scroll through cute cat pictures or funny cat memes? No one, right? Well, I have to. Because if not, then my morning is ruined. 
Because you know what? If I don't scroll through wholesome cat content that makes me smile, I scroll through something else. I get on social media, and I scroll away, and all I get with my morning coffee is bitterness and salt. Because that is what social media is right meow. I'll see the occasional viral cat thing, but for the most part, my timeline is filled with things that are not quite that sweet. That's where cat memes come in. It's where ICHC comes in. You think that just because I write on this site means that I don't use it in my daily life? It's the opposite. It's exactly why I use it. Because I know what we put up here. I know that our content is here to make people smile and help them get their mornings right.
articles.title: 25 Cat Coffee Memes to Pour a Little Laughter Into Your Cozy Cup

articles.author: Giuliana Tiscioni
articles.description:
Have you ever tried to introduce a new cat to your current cat? 
Well, I've tried, and let me tell you, it's not as easy as people think. At first, you're so excited because you think, "My furbaby won't be alone anymore when I go to work; he'll have a companion!" But then you realize it's not all rosy in the garden. 
You see, cats are very territorial animals, whether in the wild or as one of our fluffy pets. They consider their territory their own, and they can feel threatened and feel the need to protect and defend it if another cat trespasses. Granted, not all cats are so dramatic, especially not domestic ones. In my experience, most of the time they'll just be annoyed and indifferent to the new cat for a while. Then they just start tolerating each other while pretending the other one doesn't exist. Basically, that's what I did in high school with my classmates. No wonder my boyfriend says I have the purrsonality of a cat. 
Either way, what happened with my cats was something along those lines. For context, my grandmother and I live next to each other, and she has a cat who loved coming to visit. She would eat here, sleep in my bed, walk around and explore the whole place, and basically treat my house as her own. But then, one day, I brought home my current cat. It was all from one day to the next, so there was no time to try an adaptation process. My grandma's cat was not happy. She didn't attack or anything; she's not aggressive, but she refuses to come inside my house now and hisses every time she sees my cat. I'm a little sad about it, but I still get to see her when walking in the yard, when I go to Grandma's house, and I know she's well taken care of. 
In this case, we have an orange furball named Copper, who suddenly got an unexpected companion. Let's just say it'll take a while for him to process everything.
articles.title: Two wholesome orange fluffy felines have a meet-cute worthy on an enemies-to-lovers movie: ‘Copper was not a fan of the new girl’

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
Going for a walk is supposed to be pretty straightforward. You put on your shoes, head outside, get some fresh air, and eventually make your way home. But sometimes a neighborhood cat decides to join you, and suddenly your peaceful evening stroll involves making a new furry friend who has no intention of leaving your side.
Cats aren't usually the first animals we think of as walking companions, but some are enthusiastic about tagging along. They'll trot beside you, weave between your legs, and stop to make sure you're still paying attention. You might even find yourself slowing down because your new friend insists on investigating every bush along the way.
We wonder what makes certain cats so comfortable approaching strangers. Maybe they're naturally outgoing, or perhaps they've learned th…
articles.title: Couple thinks they've said goodbye to a stray cat until he comes racing back to them the next evening

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
Who needs a life coach when you've got a cat at home? These furry little philosophers seem to have everything figured out, from getting enough sleep to convincing someone else to pay all their bills. Their advice might be questionable, but they've certainly mastered the art of living comfortably.
Cats have some pretty interesting ideas about how hoomans should live. For starters, they firmly believe that getting enough sleep should be everyone's top priority. Feeling stressed? Take a nap. Have a deadline approaching? Take another nap. Someone needs you to do something important? Pretend you didn't hear them and go back to sleep. We could probably benefit from adopting at least a little of that attitude.
They've also mastered the art of setting boundaries. Cats have absolutely no problem wa…
articles.title: Wise Cat Memes With Life Lessons Nobody Asked For but Everyone Needs

articles.author: Blake Seidel
articles.description:
When a cat adopts you, resistance is futile. Especially if it's a gigantic orange cat that bites French people.
I have mixed feelings about cat cafés. On the one hand, I love having a place outside my own home where I can be surrounded by cats, and on the other hand, I feel bad for them.
The good news is that cat cafés have improved a lot in the last couple of years. When they first started, they were basically a petting zoo for cats. No one really cared for the cats' needs, as they were merely a means to bring customers into the café. Now, the purpose of most of these cafés is for cat adoption instead of being entertainment for people while they dine or sip on a cup of mediocre coffee. Of course, there are still some cafés that use them as a tool, so always do your research before visiting a cat (or any animal) café. 
Sometimes, people go there for the purrpose of finding a cat to adopt, while others, like the visitor in our "story" today from Japan, actually end up getting adopted. Simply coming in for a cup of coffee, they were warned about a purrmanently grumpy orange cat who had serious cattitude. He was notorious for knocking drinks off of tables and apparently biting French people. How he knew they were French, we have no idea, but apparently, he knew.
After a fair amount of warning, the menacing ginger cat actually climbed into their lap and started purring. Needless to say, the staff were shocked. They demanded the visitor take him home, even to the point of practically shoving adoption papers into their hands before leaving. 
Even if this story is a well-written joke, there's still a lesson in there that we could all take home with us: don't judge cats by their appearances. Some of the "grumpiest" cats I've ever met have been the biggest snuggle bugs as soon as they meet their purrson and find a place they finally feel safe. And, as always, when a cat chooses you, your fate has already been decided for you. That's just the way the Cat Distribution System works.
articles.title: Giant ginger cat built like a retired wrestler rules over Japanese cat café with an iron paw, until one visitor who just came in for coffee wins his heart and gets handed adoption papers

articles.author: Briana Viser
articles.description:
Trick or treat! 
The magic words to get strangers to open their doors to you and give you free candy. Cats trick or treat too, they just don't always tell you they're going out on the town. In honor of Halloween coming in the next few days, here at I Can Has Cheezburger, we're celebrating all month with dressed up, costumed out, cool, spooky kitties who just want some free salmon snacks. 
Cats have the most intimate relationship with Halloween, and not just black void cats either! They love the macabre, the spooky, the elaborately dressed essences of what the holiday brings to the table. And what about the coziness? There's nothing a cat loves more than to be snuggled up in soft blankets and covers, fireplace rolling, a Halloween movie on in the background while their pet loving owner cuddles them to kitty dreamland. So if you're a Halloween guy or gal with a feline friend, just know they're celebrating too! 
Halloween is my favorite holiday. I know, I know, it's a bit kitschy for fake goths or people still obsessed with Tim Burton films well into their 50s, but who said there's anything wrong with kitsch? Even if you're a 50-year-old whose phone background is Nightmare Before Christmas, it's simply important to celebrate the things that make you feel you. And for a lot of people, it's the whole spooky season, in which Halloween exists in. We're not the only ones enjoying spooky season; there's a whole society of cats celebrating witch hunts, dressing up, and doing seances behind closed doors. 
These adorable, yet spooky dressed up cat memes are the purrfect medicine for a bad day, or the inspiration you needed to get into the holiday spirit. There's something ethereal about the autumn and everything it encompasses. The grey skies, the possibility of rain, the brisk air, and the wind pushing stray leaves to and froe. So enjoy scrolling these cats in costume while you prep for Halloween.
articles.title: 22 Spooky Season Cat Memes for a Purranormal Dose of Feline Fun

articles.author: Melissa Knudson
articles.description:
Did someone say spooky and adorable cuties?
As the spooky season arrives and takes full force, old unfounded beliefs start to come back. For example, the idea that black cats are somehow unlucky. Yes, they are great at looking like little cutie vampires when they get their hungry fans out, but no; they are the first thing to be unlucky. In fact, if you're a cat parent, or you have ever met a black cat in your life, you know that is simply impossible. Black cats bring the best luck into your life, as you get to have them as the purrrfect company. The only thing spooky about these fluffy cuties is their capacity to blend with a room, so they can hunt your toes when you least expect it. Other than that, if you're a pawrent yourself, you can count yourself lucky to share your days with a black mobile piece of cloud.
That said, here's a collection to honor black cats in a season that has historically done their reputation wrong. Send this to your superstitious friends, so they can finally be convinced that being a black cat parent only makes you twice as iconic and three times more blessed. Nothing those rounded yellow perfect eyes cannot get. This collection proves that they're not only very much "awww" worthy, but they are also quite hilarious.
articles.title: 25 Meowjestic Black Cat Memes for a Spooky Season Filled With Wholesome Meows

articles.author: Bar Mor Hazut
articles.description:
What do you do with all your Halloween decorations after the spooky season is over?
All good things come to an end, and the spooky season is not far from its own end. Sure, Halloween is still ahead of us, and we still haven't gone trick-or-treating and filled our bags with a year's worth of candy, yet most of October is already behind us, so we are starting to prepare for the end of fall and the beginning of something new.
Which brings me back to the question: what do you do with all your fall and Halloween decorations? 
Some people have plenty of storage room where they can pack everything up in a box and leave it to rest until next year. The Jack-o'-lanterns, skeletons, costumes, and every single home decor item that matches the color theme of fall go into that box. It's a very efficient way to ensure you have everything you need this time next year, without having to spend any more money.
Those of us who don't have enough storage room, however, need to find other solutions to all that decoration, so they won't have to spend the next 10 months staring at Halloween decorations that have no business being there. So we stick them in a random room, continue to use fall-scented candles well into December, and find creative solutions for the random decorative pumpkins we put around the house.
articles.title: 24 Cute Cat Memes to Fall Into the Sweet Spooky Season With (October 20, 2026)

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Gather round, ladies, gents, and silly cat people - it's mustache time.
I'm not sure what makes a cat's fur pattern unique, because every cat is different from one another, but I do know this - the rarer the phenomenon, the more special it looks in our human eyes. For cats looking at other cats it matters exactly zero percent of what it matters to us. They recognize each other by smell, meow pitch, and other parameters - but special fur features? They leave this visual distinction and admiration for us humans.
But despite the fact that every cat is unique because of their character, it's still fun to look at the rare fur colors cats sport. For example, brown cats are so rare that there's no official data anywhere to determine the percentage of the brown cat population worldwide. And don't even let me start about the cat with a mohawk I saw once - he's such a rockstar with his unique fur alone!
So I want to welcome you to this silly soirée of another rare phenomenon happening on dapper tuxedo cats - their impurressive mustaches.
articles.title: A Silly Soirée of 28 Dapper Tuxedo Cats Whose Mustaches Demand to Be Taken Seriously

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Super El Niño is rough on animals just as it is on humans, but luckily for cats, they tend to adopt themselves into safety.
When the weather is extreme, cats need shelter. Strays need shelter, period. But when the weather becomes way too much, it's important that cats stay in a safe space until things calm down outside, whether from the cold or the heat. And that's especially true for when we feel the bad weather ourselves - if we're cold, they're cold. If we're hot, they're hot. And if a Super El Niño ravages the Pacific, it doesn't affect only humans. And people really do feel its effects as we speak - severe droughts, massive floods, and record-breaking global heat. This is serious.
But even amidst this serious event, a little silliness shines its light. And of course, no wonder it has to do with cats. One woman experiencing the effects of this current Super El Niño also experiences migraines - which is an annoying thing in and of itself. But some migraines are so strong they can affect your eyesight - which is exactly what she thought was happening when she saw her cat just doubled. But cats being cats, you probably already guessed this was not her eyesight making her see double. This was a cat identical to hers who simply sought a safe space from the extreme heat outside.
It's a Cat Distribution System thing - to send people a secret twin of their resident cat to make them softer for the idea of adopting them. It's a secret matchmaking technique the CDS employs, with great success. Even I took in a kitten who was identical to my cat just because he reminded me how tiny and helpless my cat was as a kitten who needed to be adopted. I was a foster for him, and he eventually went to a wonderful forever home, but the idea is similar.
articles.title: Woman opens her doors for a breeze during Super El Niño and thinks her heat migraine caused her to see double: ‘Nope, it’s an actual second cat looking like our cat.’

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
Halloween is right around the corner, and while everyone else is busy planning costumes and stocking up on candy, some cats are already dressed for the occasion. They don't need plastic fangs, fake blood, or a dramatic black cape. All they have to do is open their mouths and show off those adorable little vampire teeth.
Cats might spend most of their days sleeping in sunbeams and demanding snacks, but underneath all that fluff are some surprisingly sharp teeth. We're so used to seeing their sweet little faces that it's easy to forget they're technically tiny predators. Of course, it's difficult to take their intimidating hunting instincts seriously when they're chasing a crumpled receipt across the living room.
Some cats have little fangs that poke out even when their mouths are closed, gi…
articles.title: Love At First Bite With These Adorable Little Vampurrs And Their Tiny Fangs

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
There are few things more exciting for a cat lover than being chosen by the Cat Distribution System. You can spend years admiring other people's unexpected feline arrivals, wondering when a little furball might finally wander into your own life. Of course, the CDS doesn't take requests, and its delivery methods can be questionable.
Cats have a talent for finding strange places to hide. Give them a comfortable bed, and they'll choose the cardboard box it came in. Buy them a cat tree, and they'll squeeze behind the couch instead. We love their determination to investigate every nook and cranny, although we'd prefer they stuck to places where they can get themselves out again.
Curious kittens are particularly good at finding trouble. Their tiny size lets them slip into spaces an adult cat wou…
articles.title: Woman hears mysterious meowing outside all day and rescues the sweetest kitten from her daughter's car engine

articles.author: Celeste Mello
articles.description:
Do you know what a home is?
Bruce's new human asked him that question, and it made me think about how I would answer. Watching the newly adopted cat purr through his first night home and fall asleep hugging his human's foot made me think of the relief I feel when I'm tired and know I have somewhere familiar to come back to. Even before I get there, thinking about home helps.
To me, home means a future. It gives me the stability to think beyond the day. I know I have somewhere safe to sleep tonight, so that leaves room to consider what I want for myself tomorrow. I can start something, leave it unfinished, and come back to it. I can make plans knowing I have a place to build them from. 
I get the feeling of "home" even when I'm not there. On the way home, I begin thinking about making dinner, putting on something comfortable, and settling in for the evening. I'm lucky to know where I'm going to sleep. I know I can close the door and stay. Reaching the end of a day and having a place where I can let myself feel whatever I've been holding in feels reassuring.
articles.title: Shelter cat Bruce finally has a forever home and spends his first night purring before falling asleep hugging his human’s foot: 'I've never seen a happier cat'

articles.author: Blake Seidel
articles.description:
Why did no one tell 5-year-old me that being an adult is so hard?
If you were anything like me when I was a kid, all you wanted to do was grow up and have authority over your own life. The freedom of where to go, what to do, the world was my oyster and no one would be my boss. I was going to skip through my pre-teen and teen years, then go straight into astronaut academy and be the first purrson to land on Mars. In between space outings, I would drive my expensive car to fancy restaurants, order whatever I wanted, and go home and play video games until the sun rose.
Spoiler alert: none of those things actually happened. As you mature, you realize that being responsible for your own life isn't all it's cracked up to be. Adulting means making sure you pay your bills on time, going to the gro…
articles.title: 23 Fuzzy Funny Cat Memes For 5 Minutes of Feline Freedom From Adulting

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
Being lifelong friends with a lion is a dream most of us will never achieve. But some people do. 
Something that I think all cat people could relate to is the absolute desire to befriend all cats. Yes, all of them. Including the big ones. Heck, especially the big ones. My biggest dream is to become friends with a big cat. It's a dream that I know I will likely never achieve, but that doesn't stop it from being real. For now, I fawn over big cats in sanctuaries and zoos, and I write articles about other people living my dream. People who raise cheetahs and become their best friends. People who become part of lion prides. People who rescue bobcats, become their friends, and give them new purpose in life. 
And today, a new story to add to the list, a new person to be jealous of- sorry, to admire. A story that reminds us that the lives of big cats in the wild are not always as simple as they seem, and that our doing the right thing and helping them is sometimes more than just "nice", it's necessary. Meet Frikkie Von Solms, a 69-year-old man, and Zion, the 11-year-old rescued lion who is his best friend.
articles.title: 69-year-old man and 11-year-old shy rescued lion have been best friends since he was a cub, now they cuddle at night, ride trucks together, and go on walks side by side

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
If your cat runs away, don't lose hope too quickly. 
As a cat owner of a very lazy, very spoiled house cat, one of my worst nightmares is my cat running away. Because I know her. And I know she won't make it. Our trips to the vet are something awful. The moment she is out of the house, she starts making noises she never makes otherwise - screaming like those stray cats in fights that we hear outside sometimes. She only likes the outside when it's on the other side of a window. Then, she's happy. Loves watching birds, loves listening to the sound of cars, loves sniffing the fresh, crispy air. 24 hours would be the longest she would make it outside. Then, she would come back. And that's not just a guess, or a joke. I know that for a fact. Because it happened. 
There is no lesson to this story. I was lucky that she found her way back to me after 24 hours, and I'll tell you exactly how amazing and unlikely that was in a moment. If there is anything that I would like you to take away from this story, it's this: If your cat runs away, don't give up. Keep looking for them. Keep listening. For as long as you can handle it. Often, they want to come back. But they might need a little help finding their way.
articles.title: 'She walked right into my arms': I thought I'd lost my newly adopted kitten forever, then she came home 24 hours later in a moment I'll never forget

articles.author: Giuliana Tiscioni
articles.description:
Isn't it wonderful when the Cat Distribution System works its way into some unsuspecting hooman's life? 
Sometimes in life, the most wonderful episodes happen when we least expect them. We may find exactly what we needed without even noticing or ever looking for it. 
I believe that pets are one of those lovely life coincidences, a serendipity, if you will. We love animals because, how could we not? They're the best part of inhabiting this planet. But it's not like we're constantly looking for a new pet or a new animal to be friends with. Those come into our lives unexpectedly and just get there to make everything better and provide us with a much-needed dose of furry happiness. We can be walking down the street or driving in our car and suddenly hear a faraway barking or a high-pitched meow. In those moments, we can't just ignore it: we have to know where it's coming from and what defenseless creature needs our attention. That's pretty much how the Cat Distribution System works: finding kitties at random moments and feeling so in love with them that we have no choice but to take them with us. It's a win-win type of situation: we get a lifelong companion, and they get the love of a family. What could be better than that? 
I know what I'm talking about because that's pretty much what happened to me. My cat got into my life in the most random moment ever, and exactly when I needed her the most. My friend texted me on a Wednesday, telling me she and her husband were fostering a kitten they couldn't keep and asking if I could take her. It was so out of the blue that I didn't even know what to say, but after a little while of thinking about it, I could say nothing other than yes. 
For this guy, it was pretty much like that. He was walking down the street when he found a small furbaby out and alone in the cold. He took it home with him, and soon became the best of friends!
articles.title: Kindhearted hooman finds an abandoned kitty out in the cold, so he takes it with him to feed it and give it a furever home: 'Apparently I’m the chosen one'

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
You never know what you're going to come across on your way to work. Maybe there's an unexpected traffic jam, a dog wandering around the neighborhood, or, in one person's case, a cat walking across the street with a can of SpaghettiOs stuck on her head. That's certainly one way to make sure someone's morning commute doesn't go according to plan.
Cats have a talent for getting themselves into situations that leave us wondering what on earth they were thinking. They'll squeeze into impossibly small boxes, stick their heads into bags, and investigate just about anything that smells interesting. Unfortunately, their curiosity occasionally gets them into trouble, especially when food containers are involved.
We have no idea how this particular kitty ended up wearing a spaghetti can, but we're g…
articles.title: Person spots a cat wearing a SpaghettiOs can on the way to work and makes a decision that changes their morning

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
If there is anything that can make all people work together, it's itty bitty kittens.
In a world like ours, when the timeline is always full of clickbait and ragebait and a bunch of things that make us feel like there is no hope for humanity, this is the kind of story that we want to see. Uniquely adorable kittens being saved, and people of all ages being kind. It doesn't feel like too much to ask for. That's what the internet used to be about. It's what used to make it more fun. Before algorithms and AIs - when the internet was all about sharing funny cat memes and strange things that made people smile. 
Sometimes, it doesn't feel like there is too much that we can do to change the world and make it more pawsitive again, and then we remember… cats. We remember that no matter what madness takes over our timeline this week, among all the posts, there will be cats going viral. Cats always bring people together. We see that online all the time. And sometimes, we see that in the real world too. I can tell you from purrsonal experience, it was cats who brought me and my neighbors closer, working in shifts together to keep them all fed. And it was cats who brought the community in this story closer too - working for hours on end to save a kitten together.
articles.title: Kind kids wake the neighborhood cat lady to tell her there's a kitten trapped in a car, and after hours of many neighbors working together, they manage to save the most unique-looking brown kitten

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
During weather disasters, humans are not the only ones who need help. 
Natural disasters are one of my biggest personal fears. They come out of nowhere, there are few ways to prepare, there isn't really anyone to blame, and they are always devastating. Floods are like that. Over the past few months, some of the flooding footage that we have seen has been amazing - in the purest meaning of the word. It has left me amazed. Lives turned upside down, washed away, changed within a moment. We look at the people, the structures, but I don't think that most people think about the beautiful wildlife experiencing the same disasters too. 
Being a stray newborn kitten is hard enough as it is. Having to learn how the world functions so early and so quickly, just to survive, is hard. Having to do all of that during a flood… impossible. The itty bitty kitten in this story never had a chance to learn. The flood came out of nowhere, he was swept away, and finding her family within all that madness, when he still needed his momma there for basic needs like food, was not something that he could do. That's where we have to come in. People like us, people with compassion for animals, we can try to help. We won't be able to save them all, but every life saved is one worth celebrating.
articles.title: A flood leaves this newborn black kitten without a family, so a kind person saves him and gives him a new home: 'Last year, my home town flooded'

articles.author: Blake Seidel
articles.description:
Some days you just need a good roundup of cat tweets to make you laugh your tail off. Mondays are that day. That's why we come back every single week with the freshest and funniest, not just for you, but for us as well.
I Can Has Cheezburger started from a meme. You know the one. The internet then advanced and memes became a community activity, connecting people from around the world through their love for cats and making memes out of them. This was the era of LOLcats. Then Facebook and Instagram came out, along with Tumblr, and then Twitter (now "X"). Memes are now a dime a dozen, with hundreds, if not thousands of pages dedicated to posting memes and making others laugh. While there may not be as many pages specifically for cats, there are still quite a few more than when we started nearly 20 years ago.
All of this is to say that memes aren't what they used to be anymore. We still love them and keep the purrfect tradition of cat memes alive, but a lot of the internet has moved on already. Now, everybody wants tweets. And if that's what hte internet wants, then that's what the internet will get. We'll keep looking for the most viral, the silliest, and the funniest feline posts that the world has never seen before (because they're fresh, duh) and give them to you every Monday so that, at the very least, you know that you'll have something to make you smile on this most terrible day of the week.
Not everything needs a twist or surprise, bells and whistles, hoodads, or shebangs to make it special. These tweets are the purrfect 10 minutes of hissterical escapism that I could find. I even showed them to my cat, and she smiled. If you can't trust me, you can definitely trust her. She's a purrfect angel baby who doesn't have the capacity to lie. At least, that's what she tells me.
articles.title: 21 Best Cat Tweets of the Week for Fanatical Feline Fans of Hooman Humor

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Whatever big day with important events you're having, enlarging the cat memes to fit the occasion is always a good idea.
The I Can Has Cheezburger HQ has moved offices today. It's still quite close to where we worked before, but we're in a new building, new space, and even a view of the sea. This is quite a big step we're taking! We're still the same team, doing the same ol' cat meme-ing on the interwebs, bringing the wholesome feline side of the online sphere to cat lovers' feeds. But it still feels like a huge change, even if you can't see it on your end. Let me tell you a bit about all that's different now:
We have a studio! That's a first. It's a room just for us to create video content, with cats or without. The view I've mentioned is also a new addition, and it's always nice to sit n…
articles.title: 25 Big Cats, Big Hearts, and Big Memes for Your Big Day

articles.author: Laurent Shinar
articles.description:
After a long week at the grindstone we can all benefit from a little tender love and care. And while our cat children are less than likely to take pity upon us and our needs, we can at least enjoy a few minutes of peace and quiet while scrolling through the memes that other felines have come together to create. Proof that much like a solar eclipse, sometimes it is better to look at things side on. So we invite you to curl up on your couch, with or without your cat child and settle in for some cute and comforting cat memes.
It is the bane of every cat child pawrent, expect the very few that have purrfect little fur babies who love on them endlessly, that our felines will simply not care if we are feeling unwell, tired or simply rundown. So in place of the warmth, love and attention that we wish they could provide we can at least indulge in the comfort of some cute cat memes made by other pawrents who lucked out in the feline lottery and have a sweet cat child at home who makes them laugh and cares for them when they are unwell.
So without any further delay we invite you to settle into your curled up pawistion on the couch, perhaps close the door if your clawminal cat child is likely to intrude with zoomies and let all your stresses, worries and woes slip away. And with that we wish you a rather wonderful day.
articles.title: 20 Cute Cat Memes fur When You’re Curled Up like a Croissant on the Couch

articles.author: Briana Viser
articles.description:
Everyone loves the feeling of holding a big, warm mug in their hands. Why not fill it with cat memes? 
Ahhh, the ineffable feeling of a warm mug in your hands juxtaposed with the cold, brisk winter weather outside. There's nothing cozier than balancing the cold air with something warm. Whether that thing is a mug of hot cocoa to start your day, coffee, snuggling your favorite person, cat, or dog, or whether it's scrolling cat memes is entirely up to you. When you know what self soothes you, you know you can always help yourself. The great thing about cat memes is that you can do it anytime, anywhere, and with anyone. The warmth of their kookiness, the comedy of their capricious chaos, and the pawdorable big innocent eyes they give us are all ways to find our center.
In the morning, our brains are fragile. Our consciousness teeming with tasks for the day, to-do lists, errands, and responsibilities. Reality begins to obfuscate itself with urgency and expectation. Cat memes, however, cut through that fog. They don't clarify your problems, but they make them feel less urgent. They remind you that even the most confident creature can wake up confused, disheveled, and mildly offended by daylight. Slow morning scrolling is never something to be ashamed of. These steaming hot memes act as a buffer between sleep and society. Each swipe is a small pause, a chance to smile before the noise ramps up. A cat stretched across a keyboard. A kitten mid-yawn, mouth impossibly wide. A face that perfectly captures how it feels to be awake but not emotionally available yet.
articles.title: A Warm Mug of 31 Steaming Hot Cat Memes For Slow Morning Scrolling

articles.author: Briana Viser
articles.description:
Cat memes are here for us when we're happy, sad, and missing a piece of our childhood. 
Sometimes all we want is to be a kid again. We want to feel carefree in the world, and bereft of responsibilities. Just yesterday, my boyfriend and I decided to be kids all day. We started by having a reading date in the park across from where we live, and in fact I'm rereading a childhood favorite of mine. Then we took a long walk to the beach, and a viewpoint, and we wore our pajamas all day. Wearing pajamas and walking around like that is one of the best feelings, and definitely made me feel detached from adult responsibilities and expectations. The best part is sharing that kind of experience with him. To feel like we can both be kids without judgement is truly magical, and so are cat memes. 
Cats have something so magical about them, that we practically feel transported to being a kid again. How could you actually feel bad or worried if there's a hilarious cat staring at you? So enjoy these cat memes!
articles.title: The Chronicles of Cat Memes for Nostalgic Adults Missing the Magic of Childhood

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
It's finally cold outside. Thank goodness. And that means it's time to cozy up with some cat memes. 
Take a deep breath, everyone. Do you smell that? It's the smell of the weather getting colder and pumpkin spice in the air. Spooktober. Meowlloween. Ugh, it's one of our favorite times of the year. And our cat's too. Let me know if this is true for your cats as well, but mine… she gets so, so much cuddlier when the weather is colder. And a cuddly cat means a very happy human. At every available opportunity, she sits down in my lap. And that is a fall thing only. Not winter. In the winter, she prefers burrowing into the very warm comforter on my bed. 
Spooky season is simply the best time to get cozy. Your cat by your side, a blanket thrown over both of you, rain gently tapping your windowsill, a cup of hot cocoa in one hand, and a bunch of wholesome cat memes in the other. That is what we call purrfection. That is how you spend a lovely fall evening like this one.
articles.title: 24 Cute Cat Memes to Make Your Spooky Season Extra Cozy

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
Sunday is here, which means it's time to start thinking about the weekend. Yes, we know it's only the beginning of the week, but is there really anything wrong with having something to look forward to? We've barely recovered from our last two days off, and we're already dreaming about the next opportunity to sleep in, eat snacks, and spend some quality time with our cats.
We always start the week with big plans for the weekend ahead. Maybe we'll finally try that restaurant everyone's been talking about, catch up with friends we haven't seen in ages, or take a little day trip somewhere fun. There's also that growing list of things around the house we've been meaning to get done. Surely two whole days will be enough time to squeeze everything in.
Our cats, however, have a completely differen…
articles.title: A Purrfectly Lazy Sunday of Cat Memes and Absolutely Zero Responsibilities

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
It's pumpkin season, and cats are getting in on the fun! While the rest of us are busy decorating our homes for Halloween, some curious kitties have discovered that pumpkins make pretty great places to hang out. We have to say, they're making a strong case for being the cutest Halloween decorations around.
Cats have always had a thing for climbing inside anything they can fit into. Leave an empty cardboard box on the floor, and your kitty will probably be sitting in it before you've finished unpacking. Laundry baskets, shopping bags, and bathroom sinks are all fair game, too. So it makes sense that a hollowed-out pumpkin would catch their attention. It's basically a seasonal cat bed, although we're not sure how comfortable it actually is.
There's just so much to love about a little feline face peeking out of a pumpkin. The tiny ears, the curious eyes, and those whiskers sticking out over the edge make for an adorable sight. Some kittens are small enough to fit their entire bodies inside, while bigger cats have to settle for poking their heads through the opening. Either way, we wouldn't mind having a few of these little pumpkin dwellers decorating our homes.
We have to give some credit to the hoomans who manage to capture these moments on camera. Anyone who's tried photographing a cat knows that getting them to cooperate isn't always easy. You can have everything set up perfectly, only for your kitty to decide that the pumpkin is much more interesting from the outside. Maybe they'll give it a sniff, bat at the stem, or wander off before you can take a single picture.
Even when a cat does decide to climb inside, there's no guarantee they'll stay there long enough for a photoshoot. One second, they're sitting sweetly in their little pumpkin house, and the next, they're climbing out because they've spotted a leaf blowing across the yard. We can't blame them for being curious, but we'd definitely appreciate a few extra seconds to get the camera focused!
Pumpkins are cute, but pumpkins with whiskers are even better!
articles.title: Cute and Curious Cats Popping Out of Pumpkins for a Pawsitively Purrecious Halloween

articles.author: Laurent Shinar
articles.description: Catnappings do not happen all too often in this world thankfully, but when they do their effect is devastating. The relationship we build with cats is an incredibly deep and special one, even if we have just met and when the pawrent in this story saw their tiny kitten being scooped up right in front of their eyes and bundled into a car that sped off, well, you can imagine just how heartbroken they were. But it would turn out that their heartbreak about losing their cat would be the very thing that would come to save several animals and children who were in need of saving. It all came undone when our pawrent, with the help of social media savvy friend managed to locate the person who committed the clawminal offence of stealing their kitten. Upon arriving at their home the two were greeted w…
articles.title: Kidnapped kitten saves 3 children from neglectful mother living in rancid house

articles.author: Briana Viser
articles.description:
Bread, butter, and cat memes – what could be better?
There's something so sensory about the alliteration in bread and butter. You can easily imagine a soft knife's blade gliding against a soft slice of bread, the saltiness of the butter practically in your mouth already. And if you're hungry it might not be the best thing to think about bread and butter, but you can always use cat memes as a distraction. Cat memes can also fill you up the way bread and butter can, but with laughter and giggles and happiness. Cat memes really make the world go round, and they put a smile on our faces no matter what is happening in our lives. And if you're thinking about cats and food together, then fat cats are here too. 
Fat cats are pawdorable, there's no getting around it. Their sensational stomachs, the big belly that waddles when they walk, it's just too much sometimes. There's nothing cuter than when they curl up and just look like a gigantic ball of beauty. There's something so comforting about a hefty kitty. There's no such thing as a cat treadmill for a reason – because they don't need it! Take it from us at I Can Has Cheezburger, we're the real authorities on everything kitty. 
Hefty cats are so pawdorable simply because they're designed for maximum cuddles. Their snuggle factor is unmatched since they have more cushion for the pushin. What makes these hefty kitties wholesome isn't just their fluff—it's their energy. They're weird positions they sit in on the couch, right on their bum like they're a hooman and not a cat. Gut out and countenance shocked. They're affectionate without effort. They walk like tiny monarchs patrolling their soft kingdom. They judge you, lovingly, from atop plush blankets. And when they curl up next to you, it feels like being chosen by a warm cloud. Enjoy these chonky, lovely, beautiful, and pawdorable hefty fat cats for an afternoon scroll. Enjoy these amazing cat memes for the whole hungry family.
articles.title: The Bread and Butter of Cat Memes for Hungry Hoomans With a Taste for Feline Funnies

articles.author: Laurent Shinar
articles.description: The subject of what to do with stray cat populations is a contentious one and this story spells out a significant part of the problem surrounding the topic. There are many opinions of what is best to do, but ultimately laws, resources and the luck of having hoomans who are willing to help dictate what happens in reality. Which is how our story begins in a country where TNR is illegal and with a cat lover who took it upon themselves to trap, spay and put more than 20 cats up for adoption. Setting them up in a safe shelter until their furever home comes along. But when this thoughtful hooman was confronted by a local cat lady who was convinced our reducer was 'stealing' her cat children, well, the whole story took a turn for the strange. It turns out this woman had been hoarding these street…
articles.title: Cat lover who TNRed 20+ stray cats confronted by cat lady for ‘stealing’ her fur babies

articles.author: Sarah Brown
articles.description:
Calling cats evil is a pretty serious accusation, especially when most of them spend their days sleeping in sunbeams, begging for snacks, and trying to squeeze themselves into cardboard boxes. Sure, they can be little troublemakers, but we're not convinced that knocking a glass off the counter makes someone a villain.
Someone on X recently stirred up some feline controversy by announcing that they hate cats. Their reasoning? Cats are evil, they don't care about their humans, and there's apparently no point in having one. That's quite a lot to say about an animal you don't even like! As devoted cat pawrents, we have a few objections, starting with the idea that cats are incapable of loving their humans.
Anyone who's had a purrticularly clingy kitty knows how far from the truth that can be. …
articles.title: Person declares that cats are evil and don't care about their owners, but cat lovers have a very different opinion

articles.author: Celeste Mello
articles.description:
How did I visit Amsterdam and miss a boat full of rescued stray cats???
I wish I'd known about De Poezenboot sooner. The name means Catboat and refers to Amsterdam's floating cat shelter. The owners describe it as the only floating cat sanctuary in the world. Now my question is: why are we tourists visiting the Van Gogh Museum and not this shelter? I would have gone straight there if I knew about it. The works of art are of a different kind, but still, I bet tourists walk out of the place equally astonished by the cuteness. 
According to its official history, it all started back in 1966 when a woman named Henriette van Weelde found a mother cat and her kittens beneath a tree opposite her home. She took them in, and more cats followed, including animals whose owners could no longer care for them. She was soon recognized as the "cat lady" in the neighborhood. Two years later, she was running out of room for the animals, so she came up with the coolest idea ever: buying a boat for the cats so they could live there. Yes, she bought an old Dutch sailing barge and turned it into a cat shelter. If people can live in boats, why can't cats? Some volunteers joined her, and the Catboat Foundation became official.
articles.title: The Story Behind Amsterdam's Floating Cat Shelter, Where Rescued Cats Find a Home on the Water

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
There is no better way to start a Saturday morning than with a whole bunch of happy cats. 
We all know, in our purrsonal experience as cat owners, that our cats' lives are… pretty pawsome. Of course our cats have no idea. They don't know what the lives of stray cats look like, so they don't know how to appreciate what they have. They complain about their bowls being empty of their very expensive fancy food. They refuse to use their litterboxes if there is even one little bit of bad smell. 
These spoiled cats act like they live the hardest lives in the world. And we still love them. In fact, their little purrsonalities are what make us love them more. And it doesn't matter. We know how good their lives are. We know that one of the best things that you can do for any cat is simple… to adopt them. And newly adopted cats know that too. These cats, unlike our spoiled babies, still remember their lives on the outside. So, they actually show joy at all the little things that we provide. For a while. Until they get comfortable. Until they believe that you won't throw them out onto the streets again. And then, the shenanigans begin, their real colors show, and we grow to love them even more than we did before. Everyone, it's time to smile at this week's sweetest cat adoption stories.
articles.title: Meet the Newly Adopted Faces of the Week: 20 Heartwarming Cats Who Found Their Forever Homes (October 17, 2026)

articles.author: Mariel Ruvinsky
articles.description:
A purrfect Caturday starts with no alarm clocks and many purrfect cat meowments.
This is something that every cat purrson knows. The impurrtance of Caturday being purrfect cannot be overstated. This is the best day of the week, and if we don't start it on the right paw, we may as well give up on the whole weekend. Starting Saturday badly is a bad omen, and we refuse to let that happen. Not on our watch. Not as long as we have something to do about it. And here, on ICHC, we always do. Because all that you really need to start Caturday right is a whole bunch of purrfect cat meowments, and this is what our weekly meowgazine is here to provide. 
The best cat content of the week in one very easy-to-reach spot. First thing on Caturday morning, what your eyes are going to see are the most wholesome stories about cats and the silliest cat memes that we found. And you know you can trust us to really bring you cat purrfection here because we see all of it. It is our job. The good, the bad, the hilarious and the most heartwarming. Coming out of this listicle smiling is basically a guarantee.
articles.title: Your Weekly Meowgazine: 20 Snuggly ICanHasMoments to Make Your Caturday Full of Cozy Smiles (October 17, 2026)

articles.author: Blake Seidel
articles.description:
Some accomplishments hit harder than others: sleeping safely and soundly in your very first apartment after being homeless for nearly two years, with your cat snuggled up between your legs, might be worth more than gold.
I'm going to take this opportunity to get a little bit purrsonal. When I was a teenager, I had a brief period where I feared I would be homeless. During the early 2000s, a lot of teens were getting kicked out of their parents' homes for coming out. So much so that it was reported on the national news and even on the cover of Time magazine. I remember because I kept this issue hidden under my mattress for years, it was the only thing I had that helped me form some sort of connection to the… changes I was feeling.
I was outed by my uncle, whom I told in confidence, when I wa…
articles.title: 'He's more than "just a cat" to me': After 1.5 years of being homeless with their loyal cat, proud pawrent and feline share heartwarming photo of their first night home

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
Some things change, others stay constant, but things like lolcats are more like a sturdy pillar for I Can Hahs Cheezburger.
We're moving offices in a couple of days. That's such a huge change, and just like cats, changes this big can be scary for us hooman too. I have to admit I'm more excited than scared, but there's still a little fear in me walking into the unknown. Will the chairs be as comfortable? Is the parking space large enough for all of us? Will there be more traffic in the morning commute? I don't know. But what I do know is that while some things may change, others will stay just as they are - like the weekly lolcats, which are the cutest output on the internet.
That's the thing about big changes that might be scary - it's hard to remember they're not your entire life. Like a cat moving apartments, big changes may look like your entire life is different now. But just like a scared cat, hiding under the bed in a new home, thinking it's never going to be the same again - changes are only partial. Cats still have their loving family with them, and probably most of their toys. So the I Can Has HQ will move offices, and just as my cat did when I moved apartments with her - we'll take time to adjust, we'll explore our new environment, and remember the constants that keep us grounded, like cat memes. They're always a constant in our lives.

articles.author: Giuliana Tiscioni
articles.description:
Every creature's life is important, and we love people who go out of their way to help and protect defenseless animals! 
Sometimes, people find little kittens in danger at random moments in their lives. They help the furbaby as best as they can, but they can't always keep them in their home for good. The reasons vary from one person to the other: some already have many animals; others don't have enough space to keep them long-term, or they work too much and are many hours away from home, so they can't give the little animals the attention they need. So instead, they chose to foster them until they can find a permanent home. 
That's what my friends did, and that's how I got my cat! They were the ones who found her on the side of the road, but they couldn't keep her. For them, it was a mix of two factors: they already had animals; hence, little space for her to walk and play. They managed to keep her for a few days in a separate room so the other pets didn¿t bother her, and then they brought her to my house. 
The important thing is that they helped her out even though they couldn't keep her, and that's what we appreciate the most about people rescuing cats: even when they can't offer to be their permanent home, they help anyway. They went out of their way for a few days to offer the poor girl some food, a bath, and a warm and safe place for her to be, which is almost exactly the same as what these people did!
articles.title: Neighbors hear a crying kitten in someone's garden, they rescue him before it gets too cold and starts raining, and take him home to foster him until finding him a furever home: ‘We get to spoil this little guy’

articles.author: Cata Holmes
articles.description:
Had enough of the internet today? Need a little break from all the chaos? These sweet cats are here to help!
Why do cats have a reputation for being sassy and serious? Some people on the internet think felines are the funniest beings on Earth, while others (mainly dog people) think they are serious, judgy, and full of sass. Honestly, I think all of that is true. Cats can't fit into a single category: they are everything at once, and that's what makes them so great. It's impossible to be bored next to a cat because they always have something to say or an expression to make.
articles.title: 22 Wholesome Cats for a Softer Day on the Internet (October 17, 2026)

articles.author: Celeste Mello
articles.description:
How do cats always end up becoming the main attraction on vacation?
I can spend weeks thinking about a trip, choosing places to visit, planning all the things I want to see... Only to then notice a cat sitting somewhere, and my priorities change. I'll have to take forty pictures of this beautiful baby. I was excited about the architecture and I'll get back to it once I know whether this little guy likes visitors.
I've seen cats aboard flights that behaved very well. They even made me curious about having one as a travel companion. But then I decide I have enough trouble deciding what belongs in my suitcase, so imagine also traveling with cat stuff. I'm one of those people who becomes aware of everything they need to keep track of when I'm already in the car heading to the airport. I'm not the one who arrives 3 hours early. I'm the one who has an hour to spare and drinks coffee before boarding. Once there, I check my gate, look for my documents, and then check my bag again just in case my passport grew little legs and ran away. Seeing a cat being carried through the terminal makes me wonder how I would manage all that with a little passenger. I would probably spend the wait looking at him and forgetting to check the departure board.
When I look at my vacation photos, I'll always enjoy looking at the cat pictures that bring back those little moments. Trips are all about little moments, and cats only make them better.
articles.title: 22 Cats Claiming Suitcases, Catching Flights and Becoming the Main Attraction on Vacation

By some incredible stroke of luck, the gate happened to be open that day, allowing them to rescue her. The poor baby was covered in fleas, but she was finally safe. Over a year later, she's a beloved member of the family, keeping her two feline siblings very busy with her antics.

articles.author: Ayala Sorotsky
articles.description:
What are the chances you'll meet the absolutely right cat for you to adopt?
Being allergic to cats is tough. Not just when you walk down the street and a cute stray wants your attention, and not just when you visit a house of friends or family and they have a cat inside. It's especially tough when you actually love cats. That's how my wife is - she's allergic to cats, officially. She grew up with cats from early childhood. When her mom told her not to let the cat sleep in the same bed with her, she snuggled even closer to the cat, took a big whiff, and called it "exposure therapy". It took her two childhood cats and living with mine for a few years to stop having symptoms. So… success.
But that's not the case for every allergic person. Some carry this throughout all their lives, or at least think they're going to take this massive hindrance to giving cats love to the grave with them. But here below we have a woman, a cat lover like us, who's allergic to cats. So much so that she's never had one proper. And what do cat people who are allergic to cats do? That's right, adopt a dog. A small one, preferably, so it's as close to a cat as possible. That, for instance, can't happen with my wife - she's afraid of dogs. But that's a story for another time. And this woman from below here? She did do just that.
But you see, the Cat Distribution System works in mysterious ways. It doesn't just distribute the cats who need a home to people who will take them in - it makes sure the right cat goes to the right person. And it really does all of that matchmaking in mysterious ways, hidden from our eyes. And behind the scenes, the Cat Distribution System sometimes employs dogs as agents. That's right - a dog cat adopts the cat for you, or at least leads you to the cat you're supposed to adopt. So you might ask, "What are the chances you'll meet the cat who's just right for you?" Well, with a dog agent of the CDS, very high. Even if you're "insanely allergic to cats"…
articles.title: Cat lover who’s very allergic to cats adopts a dog, and on a daily walk she leads her to the one cat who doesn’t set off her allergies: 'Welcome home, Willow.'

articles.author: Blake Seidel
articles.description:
Unless you're a veteran Cheezburger lover from pre-2007, you've probably heard us throw around the term "LOLcats" before, but do you know where it really comes from? 
Welcome to our I Can Has Cheezburger hisstorian's guide to the rise of feline royalty. 
Gather 'round, fellow feline fanatics, meme meowsters, and distinguished scholars of the ancient art of catposting. Today, we're dusting off our internet archives and embarking on a journey through one of the most impawtant cultural movements of the digital age: the rise of the LOLcat. 
Listen up, youth! Yes, there was a time before TikTok and Instagram. We were the "go play outside and don't come back in unless one of you is hurt" generation. Then, somewhere along the way, computers were introduced, and we even had computer classes in school. The internet was young, the pixels were plentiful, and the spelling was absolutely atrocious. We're talking, of course, about the glorious era of "I CAN HAS CHEEZBURGER?"
We can't just give our thanks to the first meme creators, but we definitely will later in this article. My goal in this awwducational anthology is to show you that our LOLcats history goes much further back than the age of the internet, and how many steps were taken to get to the meowdern meme culture we have today. Those reaction memes you save and send to your friends or coworkers are there because of a rich history of people being obsessed with their cats.
Get comfy - it's time we begin.
articles.title: Teh Hisstory of LOLcats: How silly kitties conquered the internet, one cheezburger at a time
